launches.title: mailX by mailwarm - Instant deliverability diagnostics for AI agents & humans.
launches.tagline: mailX tells you why emails go to spam and how to fix it, via web, API, and MCP.
launches.body:
Hey YC

I’m [Amine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bengeekly/), CTO of Mailwarm (YC S20) and today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).\
[Thami](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thami-benjelloun/) is the CEO, [Othman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/othmankatim/) is our Head of deliverability and we are ready to help you with all your email deliverability problems.

We’ve been working on email deliverability since 2020. Mailwarm started as an email warmup tool and became [#1 Product of the Day](https://www.producthunt.com/products/mailwarm) on Product Hunt. Since then, we’ve helped thousands of teams improve sender reputation and inbox placement.

Today, we’re building a broader email deliverability ecosystem:

* **Mailwarm** helps teams build sender reputation through real inbox interactions.
* **mailX** helps humans and AI agents diagnose deliverability issues.
* **MailAdept** helps companies fix and monitor deliverability continuously with AI agents and human experts.

Today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/836ee2bb-f82d-4b97-9c90-c77c6d0d62f0)

---

## TL;DR

**mailX tells you why your emails go to spam and how to fix it.**\
You can run a deliverability check from the web, use it through a JSON API, or plug it directly into AI agents through MCP.

No signup.\
No API key.\
Free to use.

Try it here: [**https://themailx.com**](https://themailx.com)\
MCP endpoint: [**https://themailx.com/mcp**](https://themailx.com/mcp)

---

You can also book a call with one of our email deliverability expert [HERE](https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx).

## 🚨 The Problem

Email deliverability is technical, your marketing team can’t handle it.

Email is still one of the most important growth channels for startups.

Founders use it for cold outreach.\
Sales teams use it for outbound.\
Marketing teams use it for campaigns.\
Products use it for onboarding, activation, and transactional emails.

But when emails start going to spam, most teams don’t really know why.

They check random tools.\
They look at raw DNS records.\
They ask ChatGPT.\
They change things blindly.\
They wait and hope inbox placement improves.

The problem is not only that deliverability is technical.

The real problem is that most tools show data, but don’t explain what matters or what to fix.

And now, with AI agents sending emails, monitoring systems, and managing workflows, this problem gets bigger.

Agents need access to live deliverability tools too.

---

## 💡Our Solution

**mailX is a free deliverability diagnostic platform for humans and AI agents.**

With mailX, you can analyze a domain in seconds and get a clear report showing:

* What is working
* What is broken
* Why it matters
* What to fix next

The web app gives founders, marketers, sales teams, and developers a simple way to understand why emails may go to spam.

The API and MCP server make the same tools available to AI agents and developer workflows.

So instead of copying DNS records into different tools, your agent can directly check email authentication, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and deliverability signals.

---

## ⏳How it works

1. Enter a domain on [**themailx.com**](http://themailx.com)
2. mailX runs a live deliverability audit
3. You get clear issues, explanations, and fixes
4. Developers can use the JSON API
5. AI agents can use the MCP endpoint directly

The best part is that you can lets you AI Agent fix your deliverability or directly integrate it to your Claude or ChatGPT.

Here’s a quick demo of mailX:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YWmV7-wthQI>

In the demo, we show:

* Running a domain audit
* Getting clear fixes
* Using the MCP/API layer for AI agents and developers

We currently support checks and tools for email authentication, DNS records, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and record generation.

---

## Why now?

Email deliverability used to be something only email experts cared about.

Today, every startup relying on outbound, lifecycle emails, AI SDRs, or automated email workflows needs to understand it.

At the same time, AI agents are becoming part of the stack.

But agents need tools.\
They need live data.\
They need safe, structured ways to diagnose and act.

That’s why we made mailX available through:

* Web app
* JSON API
* MCP server
* Agent skill
* LLM discovery endpoints

Our belief is simple:

**Email deliverability should be understandable for humans and usable by AI agents.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/ffc97aad-6864-4525-a89d-0aa1f7890289)

---

## Backstory

In 2019, we failed a startup after 2 years of work.

After that, we decided to test ideas much faster: one launch per week.

Every launch used the same growth channel: email.

Cold emails.\
Partnership emails.\
Launch emails.\
Follow-ups.

That’s when we understood something obvious: If your emails don’t land in the inbox, nothing else matters.

That led us to build Mailwarm in 2020.

After years helping thousands of teams improve deliverability, we kept seeing the same pattern: People don’t know why they land in spam.\
And even when they see the data, they don’t know what to fix.

mailX is our answer to that.

---

---

## 🙏 Our Ask

We’d love your feedback from the YC community.

If you are doing cold email, email marketing, transactional email, or building AI agents that send or monitor emails, try mailX and tell us what is missing.

Also, if you are building an AI agent or workflow where email deliverability matters, we’d love to talk.

Try mailX: [**https://themailx.com**](https://themailx.com)\
Book a call through MailAdept if you want help choosing the right setup: [https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx](https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx?month=2026-05)

launches.tagline: Software teams use Waypoint to build, orchestrate, deliver, and monitor email notifications – with little to no code.
launches.body:
### **Hi 👋**

We’re Jordan and Carlos and we’re excited to share our new product called [Waypoint](https://www.usewaypoint.com/). Waypoint makes it easy for software teams to design, orchestrate, monitor product-triggered emails. Think of it as an email delivery service that is geared for data-rich transactional emails (like order confirmations, reminders, receipts, alerts, and other system notifications).

### **The problem**

Adding data-rich email notifications to software in 2023 is still a pain. Most email tools are repurposed marketing email builders for templates with little to no dynamic data. This means getting data into branded templates and setting up logic around them (eg. delays) still requires significant code within your code base. Additionally, existing tools are lacking from an observability standpoint which makes it difficult for developers to test and debug.

While it’s easy to hate on emails, the truth is that emails still act as the ‘[glue of UX](https://www.usewaypoint.com/blog/transactional-emails-the-glue-of-ux-for-marketplaces)’ for most platforms and it is often the key to onboarding and engaging users.

### 

### **The solution**

\
**Demo video (4.5 min)**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VVz4cupc8gA>

\
**Design**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71975&key=user_uploads/18473/8cfed776-9039-4bee-8f46-0d679c59d098)

* Create templates that match your brand in minutes.
* Use our block-based template builder that works seamlessly with [Liquid templating](https://liquidjs.com/) and [Markdown](https://www.markdownguide.org/).
* Build with confidence knowing templates render well across clients and devices.

\
**Orchestrate**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71975&key=user_uploads/18473/610a5230-8d68-4cd8-b6a2-3924c2cd6731)

* Trigger templates and workflows using our simple [developer friendly API](https://www.usewaypoint.com/docs).
* Automate workflows with conditionals and delays using a visual builder.
* Deliver emails reliably through world-class infrastructure.

\
**Monitor**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71975&key=user_uploads/18473/aa5c76c1-3ae6-4c24-9c22-587d837d450e)

* See a full timeline of events. From initial trigger to clicks.
* Be informed of bounces or any other exceptions.
* Log a receipt of the full email content and data variables for every mail.

\
**Customer quote**

> _"Waypoint team and support surpassed our expectations, ensuring a seamless transition from Sendgrid. Their liquid templating simplified the conversion of our existing emails, and since migrating, their service has been flawless. Our emails no longer end up in spam folders, leading to an impressive increase in our onboarding conversion rates. Waypoint's fast and reliable deliverability has taken our account verification success from below 50% to nearly 100%.”_

– Dallin Dyer, CTO of [Dree.com](http://Dree.com)

### 

### **Interested?**

We’d love to help. [Request access](https://www.usewaypoint.com/access) on [Waypoint](https://www.usewaypoint.com/) and mention ‘Launch YC’ to get to the front of the waitlist.

launches.title: Forage Mail - Simplify your inbox
launches.tagline: AI that solves email overwhelm. Not another mail app.
launches.body:
Hey Launch YC, I’m Richie, cofounder of Forage Mail! 👋

Forage has seriously changed my relationship to my inbox, and I'm excited for more of you to experience it.

[Watch demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fM9X4DhtlJk)

# **The Problem**

 Email is the glue that holds our lives together. Calendar invites, receipts, notifications, newsletters, (and more) all end up in our inbox. But, it's like a digital junk drawer that other people put things in and then we have to sift through them every day.\
\
And it never ends! Even if we get to the bottom today, it just fills back up again tomorrow.

# **What is Forage Mail?**

Forage is not a new email app you need to learn. It’s an AI that plugs right into your Gmail account and filters out your low-priority mail. Then, it sends you a clean daily summary with everything it filtered out—including a TLDR of every newsletter you received.\
\
Forage AI auto-labels emails, learns from your preferences, and gives you full control with custom rules. You can continue using any email app you prefer while Forage works in the background to streamline your inbox.

\
**Works with every mail app**\
Forage doesn’t replace your mail app. It connects to your Gmail account and runs in the background. So you can continue checking email as usual.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/aa81e95d-0fc4-4db3-b556-d688020466f6)

\
**A beautiful daily summary**\
Forage sends you a daily summary email with everything it filtered out of your inbox. It groups emails by type and summarizes your newsletters—this makes it easy to skim, scan, and move on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/96d9596d-b4d9-4f30-b5a8-01e8db5aeed0)

\
**A TLDR for every newsletter**

Ever find it hard to keep up with your favorite newsletters. Now, you can get the key points in your daily summary email and decide which articles you want to read in-full. Forage even gives you an estimated read time for each article.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/2321939a-c461-4a89-8993-b51a305de075)

\
**Protects your inbox from unwanted senders**

Forage makes it easy to unsubscribe from any sender with one click. You can also mute entire categories of email so they never show up in your inbox. Sometimes, senders don’t respect your unsubscribe request, but Forage is able to hide them anyway.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/aa638edf-f448-422e-a003-f49726b5ea1e)

\
**You’re always in control**

Forage AI makes intelligent decisions so it works well out-of-the-box. It learns from your preferences so it gets smarter the longer you use it. You can also create custom rules so you can decide exactly how your email is handled.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/418dd868-14e5-4f10-ae8d-b1f39fc27ef1)

# **How to get started**

Forage takes 30-seconds to set up. All you need to do is connect your Gmail account and Forage will create your first summary with the last 24 hours of email in your inbox. Then it will continue monitoring for new emails going forward.\
\
_We have a 14-day free trial, and you can get 10% off for life using the discount code LAUNCHYC10._\
\
We’d love to hear your ideas, feedback, and questions!\
\
Special thanks to all the early testers who have helped guide the product over the last few months. You all are real ones. Thank you!

launches.body:
**tl;dr:** _Recent changes to email protocols allow websites to be embedded in emails. _[_Zaymo_](https://zaymo.com/)_ is the first email design tool that allows users to complete actions, like shop for products, directly inside an email. Our interactive emails have brought in 27% more revenue than existing solutions._

[**🧠**](https://emojipedia.org/brain) **no-brainer ask**: If you’re reading this, you can **gift a free trial with Zaymo.** We don’t offer free trials outside of this post. Intro a Shopify brand to [founders@zaymo.com](mailto:founders@zaymo.com) and you’re good to go :)

### problem

* **1 - 3% conversion rates** at best from e-commerce emails
* However, e-commerce stores attribute **\~20 - 30% of total revenue** to email marketing
* Interactive emails work well, but cross-platform compliance means **implementation requires several hours of coding** for a single email

### solution

Marketers can build reliable interactive emails in minutes with Zaymo. Here’s an email that increases orders for subscription brands and improves retention.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78528&key=user_uploads/1176709/e8941b14-5a3b-4569-b423-c76a17cd1f83)

Zaymo supports the following:

* In-email abandoned cart recovery
* In-email one-click subscription upsell
* In-email Campaigns
* In-email Review collection
* In-email Forms

Eventually, we’ll support hundreds of use cases.

launches.title: Proxis - the first dedicated platform for LLM distillation and serving
launches.tagline: Model serving optimizations to reduce compute costs.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** [Proxis](https://www.proxis.ai/) is the first dedicated platform for LLM distillation and serving, unlocking production ready models at 1/10th of the cost.

### The Problem

* Fine-tuning frontier models like GPT-4 on proprietary data is expensive, and locks customers into one external closed source model provider. 
* These large models are 100x the price per-token of smaller Llama 3.1 models, and run nearly 10x slower. This makes them impractical to deploy at scale.
* Closed source model lock-in means customers can’t tweak or tune their own model, or deploy on-prem for sensitive data solutions. 

### The Solution

Model Distillation:

* In model distillation, a large **teacher model** effectively fine tunes a smaller **student model** without the need for _labeled_ or _structured_ datasets. This ‘condenses’ large models down to the compute cost of small models.
* Distillation results in near-frontier model quality, with efficient performance. This means we can achieve 5x the speed at 1/10th the cost.
* With the release of Llama 405b in late July, open source frontier distillation became available to the public for the first time. 

### Growth & Market

* Llama model downloads have grown 10x in the last year and are approaching 350 million downloads to date. There were 20 million downloads in the last month alone, making Llama the leading open source model family.
* Llama usage by token volume across major cloud service providers has more than doubled in just three months from May through July 2024 when Llama 3.1 was released.
* Monthly usage (token volume) of Llama grew 10x from January to July 2024 for some of the largest cloud service providers.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdQSaqElsFW5E2grv46IezSDDiWOQKb8xcXqzf9FzWYnY8s0DywELRQaJpXNRWRxIqFsJwL_Nt_eJawi2BaNk-QasNFOv0tm8efkn3DwhfxHqH-8jizsSQMZnZiGW3yfBZNHdWz9lVME9vuxqcbBp_kETp4?key=EmGuREnt2lr1tUSBSUm-SQ)

Source: [Meta](https://ai.meta.com/blog/llama-usage-doubled-may-through-july-2024/)

### The Team

[Jackson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jacksonstokes/) (CTO, on the left) **optimized the Gemini model at Google** for efficient deployment at massive scale. [Liam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/liam-collins-/) (CEO, on the right) built zero-to-one systems as a software engineer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83633&key=user_uploads/1592615/ea47fdba-f119-4680-8d1e-e394d6e85273)

launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Allen and Advait from Friday and we are using AI to help you reduce your email inbox to only the most essential emails, teaching your assistant how to handle the rest.\
\
**TLDR:** Email sucks, and takes forever. Most of your emails don’t require you to personally handle them. So, like a human assistant, Friday will draft responses, perform outreach and follow up, text you when you get urgent emails, get rid of clutter, and more, so you can focus on the dozen or so actually important emails in your inbox.

Friday is meant for anyone who would benefit from having an assistant manage their inbox. If you want to automate 99% of your emails, [try Friday](https://www.fridaymail.ai/) right now!\
<https://youtu.be/2Dq11hlJhqs>

### **The Problem:**

Email sucks. You either spend hours dealing with all the emails in your inbox, or you ignore them.

It takes forever, and hiring a human assistant is costly and introduces privacy concerns.

### **The Insight:**

The reality is that almost all of the emails you receive resemble emails that you have dealt with before.

So, you can just tell an AI what kind of emails you get, and tell it exactly how to handle those emails, and it can just do it for you.

Now, you only have to deal with the important, fun, or unique emails, forever eliminating the chore of going through your inbox.

### **The Solution:**

# **Smart Inbox**

You can tell Friday the kinds of emails you get using natural language, and then define actions that Friday should take once those emails come in.

For example:

* When you get an investor email, Friday gives personalized answers to their questions and sends them a meeting link.
* If a customer has an urgent request, have Friday text you so you can respond to them immediately.
* Follow up with clients that take forever to answer their email, until they respond (they should use Friday).
* If you get customer support emails, Friday answers their questions based on its memories and forwards the interaction to your cofounder.
* Summarize all the notifications from GitHub, Linear, Google, etc., and then archive those emails
* Whenever you get a new customer, Friday can search the web and write a personalized email to all of them, answering any questions they may have, immediately
* And so much more!

Just take a look at your inbox, see the emails that aren’t extremely important, and let Friday handle those emails from now on, so your inbox is left with the 5 emails a day that you want to personally handle.

# **Personal Assistant**

Friday also lets you chat with your personal assistant. You can have it reply to emails, check your inbox, send out personalized outbound, and more!

For example, if you wanted a meeting with Garry, you could ask Friday to go through your previous email history with Garry, perform a web search to learn more about Garry, and using what it knows about you, write a personalized email to him.

You can give it a dozen names or emails, and it’ll do research and write personalized emails to all of them that can be approved and sent out with a single message.

Getting this right is difficult, so everyone else settles with trying to help you go through your email twice as fast. If you want to go 100x as fast, you shouldn't spend even a second on useless emails.

### **Our Ask:**

**This product is meant for anyone who would benefit from having an assistant manage their inbox. If you want to automate 99% of your emails, **[**try Friday**](https://www.fridaymail.ai/)** right now!**

**Happy Friday!**

launches.tagline: Give AI agents their own email inboxes
launches.body:
# TLDR

AgentMail is the first email provider for AI agents. Use our API to give your agents their own email inboxes.

# Why?

We started building email agents because they can live within users’s inboxes in their inboxes and authenticate themselves with third-party applications. But building on top of legacy providers such as Gmail is a struggle. They

* Lack API support for creating new inboxes
* Charge monthly subscriptions per inbox
* Impose restrictive rate and sending limits
* Offer poor developer experience

These providers don’t scale with both inbox creation or volumes of emails sent/received that AI agents often face, so we’re rebuilding email infrastructure from scratch to enable this.

# Solution

AgentMail is an API-first email provider that gives agents their own inboxes to send, receive, and act upon emails. Think of it like Gmail, but with

 1. Programmatic inbox creation and management
 2. Usage-based pricing scaling with emails sent/received
 3. No restrictive rate/sending limits
 4. Real-time events over webhooks and websockets
 5. Simple API key auth – no OAuth headaches
 6. Built-in API permissions and agent guardrails
 7. Semantic search across every inbox in organization
 8. Automatic labeling with user-defined prompts
 9. Structured data extraction
10. And more on the way!

# Demo

In this demo, we show how easy it is to build an email agent with AgentMail: https://youtu.be/1V7BISeFUTM

In this demo, we show an example of a voice + email agent built with AgentMail: [https://youtu.be/eG2fCsRK4RY](https://youtu.be/eG2fCsRK4RY?feature=shared)

# Ask

If you are building agents that could use email capabilities, we would love to learn more about your company. You can reach us at [founders@agentmail.cc](mailto:founders@agentmail.cc)

launches.body:
Hey everyone we’re Harsha and Dhruv from Slashy. Our goal is to define the next generation of email, by building an email platform that actually works for you, and learns over time. \
\
**TLDR:** Slashy is the next big email platform after Superhuman, the first with an assistant built in. Slashy can do everything from writing drafts in your tone, texting you when an important email comes in, prepping you for calls, to the things you expect from a true email client like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, a mobile app and more. All while continuously learning about you and your preferences, so it only gets better over time. The average user takes 5 minutes to get set up and saves an extra hour a day. Read an independent review from Tom’s guide (1m+ subscribers) [here](https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/slashy-is-the-ai-email-app-replacing-notion-mail-heres-why).

You can get started for free at [slashy.com](http://slashy.com), and use our YC deal for a long-term discount.

**Launch Video:** <https://youtu.be/o2TN-wwCYm8>

## **Problem**

Most founders we speak to, have one of two problems (sometimes both)

1. They spend too much time manually handling email, and not enough building their company.
2. They don’t spend enough time on email, and lose important deals/hires due to things slipping.

## **Solution**

That’s why we built Slashy, the first email platform that reliably gets work done for you, whether it be drafting emails, notifying you when a prospect replies, schedule meetings, or more. Slashy works wherever you work best, so onboarding is seamless (just ask some of our users). It takes 10 minutes to set up, and saves the average email power user an extra one hour a day. It does this by:

1. **Doing all the basic things right:** Stuff like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, unified inbox, team comments, availability links, all come part of Slashy. So you don’t lose anything transitioning from Gmail, Superhuman, Front and more. ([@Jayme Hoffman](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/60463) actually switched to Slashy being surprised just that a new email client could match the speed, shortcuts of something like Superhuman)
2. **Writing drafts that sound like you:** Claude drafts sound like slop because they just look at the thread. Slashy does a lot more, it looks at the linkedin/web of recipients, past emails you’ve sent, past changes you’ve made to prior drafts, and more including using our own custom-built memory system for email. (Fun fact we have a special tool for handling suggesting times/scheduling as base llms are very bad at this). ([@Michelle Marcelline](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/379052) pretty much just hits send on all her Slashy drafts with minimal edits)
3. **A powerful sidebar:** Slashy comes with a cursor-like sidebar. That lets you do things like search, draft, schedule and more. So you no longer need to keep flipping between ChatGPT and your email. ([@Yahia Bakour](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2538368) loves this to power thorugh drafts and replies)
4. **Integrations:** Slashy connects to not just your email, but your meeting notes (Granola, Fathom, Circleback, etc.), crm (Attio, Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.), Notion and more since the context to handle email isn’t just in email. ([@Pavlos Markesinis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2511438) loves how Slashy connects to his Attio and makes life simple)
5. **Automations:** The best assistants also know when to handle things in the background. So Slashy can also automatically do things like prep you for calls, text you when an important email comes in, and more. ([@Owen Botkin](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2579867) relies on Slashy to prep him from calls, and [@Pranav Madhukar](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1531197) doesn’t even check his email anymore unless Slashy alerts him an email comes in)
6. **iMessage/Slack Bot:** One of the worst parts of traditional clients? You need to open them to see if something important comes in. Slashy can ping you on text/slack so you don’t even need to context switch. (@devansh is one of our bigger Slack fans, while [@Abhinav Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/979064) for iMessage).
7. **Voice:** Sometimes it’s easier to speak your mind than write (or you’re driving and just can’t haha). So Slashy lets you dictate your thoughts, and our AI will make it sound like a much better version of you. Or you can talk with our voice to voice agent when you’re commuting (@vishruth is one of our power users for our voice drafts).
8. **Personalized Memory:** Slashy gets better the more you use it. It keeps notes on how you write, who you talk to, when you schedule, and also it learns from every edit you made before hitting send. It even once a week goes back and rewrites its notes to better match you. After all you'd expect a human assistant to be smarter after a few months, why not your ai one. ([@Devraj Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2057015) loves how Slashy has grown to know him more and more).
9. **Natural Language Labels:** A common complaint we hear is the rise of the AI SDR, and how everyone’s inbox is inundated with emails. The problem with traditional labelling systems is they don’t adjust over time, leading to important emails getting missed. Slashy’s labelling system does, leading to a much better filtering rate, and fewer dropped balls. ([@Nazli Danis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/520906) was drowning in spam before Slashy)

## Security and Privacy

We take security/privacy as an email client very seriously.  We’ve already gotten CASA, and SOC II. We also get monthly pen-tests done by [@Casco](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30477) to ensure our users' data is safe. None of our AI providers train on your data as well.

## Getting Started

Now if you want to get started just go to[ slashy.com](http://slashy.com), or you can book a time here if you’d like me to demo the product/ask any questions just shoot an email to [founders+ea@slashy.com](mailto:founders+ea@slashy.com), and Slashy will schedule a time that works for both of us :)

**We built an AI agent that connects to your Gmail, Slack, Notion, and more to complete work autonomously.**

# [usedash.ai](http://usedash.ai) | [founders@usedash.ai](mailto:founders@usedash.ai)

## The Problem

Knowledge workers spend 90% of their time on manual, repetitive tasks that could be automated. Current AI tools like ChatGPT operate in isolation; they can't update Notion databases, search across Slack, or send emails.

## Our Solution

Dash is an AI agent that connects to your tools (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Docs, HubSpot, calendar, and more) to complete entire tasks.

https://youtu.be/kFPAxXAUlq8

## Real Examples from Beta Users

**"Weekly team update"**

* Reads Slack channels for key discussions
* Checks Linear tickets for sprint progress
* Pulls metrics from HubSpot and Notion
* Compiles and emails formatted report

**"New enterprise lead follow-up"**

* Adds leads to Hubspot with enriched data
* Creates qualification tasks in Linear
* Schedules follow-up calls in calendar
* Notifies team in Slack with context

**"Daily standup agenda"**

* Pulls yesterday's completed Linear tickets and today's planned work for team members
* Generates standup summary in Notion

## We're Looking For

**Know someone who is tired of switching between tools instead of making a real impact?**

We're perfect for folks who are tired of context-switching between Notion, Slack, emails, docs and more.

Perfect for:

* **Founders** 
* **PMs** 
* **Operations folks**

**Try it for free:** [usedash.ai](http://usedash.ai)
